title: tnt-bug-measurement
description: Fix the initial velocity angle of primed TNT. Used to understand bug MC-298743.
body: Fixes the direction of the velocity a primed TNT initially has. Get started by starting with the command `/tnt <...>`. Replace <...> with one of the suggestions until the command works. Also have a look at the [README](https://github.com/GuiTaek/tnt-bug-measurement/blob/main/README.md) that serves as WIKI. Used to understand bug MC-298743.
